options.content:
### Home energy accounting · estimated costs
**Calendar selections:** [This hour](/d/home-energy-insights?from=now%2Fh&to=now) · [Today](/d/home-energy-insights?from=now%2Fd&to=now) · [Yesterday](/d/home-energy-insights?from=now-1d%2Fd&to=now%2Fd) · [This month](/d/home-energy-insights?from=now%2FM&to=now) · [Last month](/d/home-energy-insights?from=now-1M%2FM&to=now%2FM) · [This year](/d/home-energy-insights?from=now%2Fy&to=now) · [Last year](/d/home-energy-insights?from=now-1y%2Fy&to=now%2Fy).

**How to read:** KPI totals use cumulative meter readings at both boundaries of the *selected* Grafana time range; these give calendar day/month/year values with the shortcuts (not 30/365-day approximations). Charts below show independent rolling 1h/24h/30d increments. Hourly/daily chart buckets can differ from local calendar boundaries at DST changes. **Euro amounts are illustrative**: the tariff boxes above default to figures inferred from supplier screenshots, not verified contract prices. Costs assume constant prices across the entire selection and approximate per-day fixed charges. 2026 annual saldering, supplier-specific return charges/tax corrections and the 2027 regulation change are **not** modelled as an official bill. No reading close to a boundary = **No data**, not zero.

targets.expr: (((sum(last_over_time(dsmr_electricity_import_total_kwh_tariff_1{job="dsmr-p1-prometheus-exporter"}[15m])) - sum(last_over_time(dsmr_electricity_import_total_kwh_tariff_1{job="dsmr-p1-prometheus-exporter"}[15m] offset 1h))) * ${elec_t1_eur_kwh} + (sum(last_over_time(dsmr_electricity_import_total_kwh_tariff_2{job="dsmr-p1-prometheus-exporter"}[15m])) - sum(last_over_time(dsmr_electricity_import_total_kwh_tariff_2{job="dsmr-p1-prometheus-exporter"}[15m] offset 1h))) * ${elec_t2_eur_kwh}) - ((sum(last_over_time(dsmr_electricity_export_total_kwh_tariff_1{job="dsmr-p1-prometheus-exporter"}[15m])) - sum(last_over_time(dsmr_electricity_export_total_kwh_tariff_1{job="dsmr-p1-prometheus-exporter"}[15m] offset 1h))) * ${credit_t1_eur_kwh} + (sum(last_over_time(dsmr_electricity_export_total_kwh_tariff_2{job="dsmr-p1-prometheus-exporter"}[15m])) - sum(last_over_time(dsmr_electricity_export_total_kwh_tariff_2{job="dsmr-p1-prometheus-exporter"}[15m] offset 1h))) * ${credit_t2_eur_kwh}) + (((sum(last_over_time(dsmr_electricity_export_total_kwh_tariff_1{job="dsmr-p1-prometheus-exporter"}[15m])) - sum(last_over_time(dsmr_electricity_export_total_kwh_tariff_1{job="dsmr-p1-prometheus-exporter"}[15m] offset 1h))) + (sum(last_over_time(dsmr_electricity_export_total_kwh_tariff_2{job="dsmr-p1-prometheus-exporter"}[15m])) - sum(last_over_time(dsmr_electricity_export_total_kwh_tariff_2{job="dsmr-p1-prometheus-exporter"}[15m] offset 1h)))) * ${feedin_fee_eur_kwh}) + (${elec_fixed_eur_day} * (1/24)))
